text:
Jia Chen: kicking off aurelia12b-int4 canary. seeing OOMs on some mid-long completions (~1200-2000 tokens). storing logs here: s3://canaries/aurelia12b/int4/run-1798801234
Samir Patel: can you paste the error lines? stack trace or allocator msg helps
Jia Chen: here — truncated:
```
E [allocator] cudaOutOfMemory: failed to allocate 1.2 GiB (requested)
  context: kv_cache_alloc at runtime/kv_cache.cpp:142
  note: free blocks: 256MiB, largest free: 128MiB -> fragmentation
```
Marco Ruiz: fragmentation looks likely. model's shard layout + int4 workspace are spiky. what's current router max_new_tokens default for this canary?
Jia Chen: router default = 1024, per-route override not set. batch size = 8, prefetch = on, kv_trim = off.
Priya Anand: immediate mitigations to try (short experiments):
- lower default max_new_tokens to 512 for aurelia canary route
- enable kv_trim with threshold 0.6
- reduce batch size to 4 for int4 variant
- disable prefetch for this canary (prefetch seems to increase transient allocations)
Samir Patel: agree. also try reserve_slot=1 (holds a small contiguous buffer to reduce fragmentation-induced OOMs).
Jia Chen: running short tests now. will also compare prompt-quality vs lingua-13b baseline (we had quality concerns on some instruction prompts)
ops-bot: canary deploy queued: deploy/aurelia12b-int4-canary-1798801300 -> starting
Jia Chen: quick perf numbers (after applying batch=4, max_new_tokens=512, kv_trim on, reserve_slot=1):
- p50 latency: 230ms -> baseline lingua13b p50 210ms
- p95 latency: 1.1s -> baseline 0.9s
- tokens/unit cost: +6% vs lingua13b
- OOMs: 0 observed in 1k requests (previously ~1.8% of requests)
Priya Anand: promising. quality diff on eval set A: rouge/bleu unchanged for most prompts, small regressions on long-form summarization. want to run 5k evals with temperature sweep.
Marco Ruiz: if quality regression persists, try tuning quantization (switch int4-gptq to int8 or try refined per-layer quant tables) and re-run. but for immediate production safety we should keep new defaults (max_new_tokens=512, batch=4, kv_trim on, reserve_slot=1) and monitor.
Samir Patel: create rollout plan: canary 5% -> 20% -> 50% with automated rollback on OOM spike >0.5% or latency p95 >2s. I'll add canary alerts to the route.
Jia Chen: thanks — I'll open an eval run and a /tickets entry with config diff. tagging @Priya to own eval sweep. :thumbsup:
Priya Anand: on it, starting eval sweep now, will post results in this thread.
ops-bot: canary deploy finished: deploy/aurelia12b-int4-canary-1798801300 SUCCEEDED
Jia Chen: initial 5k eval queued (eval-id: ev-1798801500). leaving notes in run: tried reserve_slot tweak and kv_trim; logs in s3.
Samir Patel: great, keep an eye on fragment metrics (largest_free_block, free_blocks_count) and evict churn. if fragmentation remains high we can consider memory compaction pass between requests (costly though).
Priya Anand: eval sweep complete — quick summary: quality delta vs lingua13b on eval-A: mean ROUGE -0.6, but in longform subset -1.8. attaching more details to ticket.
Jia Chen: thanks all — plan to hold default change for 24h after monitoring, then ramp if stable. closing here once rollout passes 24h without regressions.
Priya Anand: adding postmortem-style notes to the ticket to capture tuning steps and config snippets for future onboardings.
